subject: a lantern connected to its folded solid shadow
pose: lamp leaning slightly into its own shadow staircase
requested_medium: cinematic object study with solid shadow
art_direction: 一盏方灯的影子折成实体台阶并回接灯脚，琥珀玻璃与紫色折影构成不可能结构。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Place a compact square lantern above a shadow that has become a solid violet staircase. The folded shadow rises from the ground and reconnects to the lantern foot, creating one impossible closed structure. The lantern has amber glass, a dark teal frame, and a small plain carrying handle. Its light remains contained within the glass and along the nearest stair edge. Render glass thickness, tiny frame joints, and the matte folded shadow as distinct materials. Tilt the lantern a few degrees, making it appear to lean into its own strange support. Use a pale stone background and a centered three-quarter composition, with the whole object occupying the safe inner circle of the square.
